description: This file implements a custom HTTP server for testing purposes, including request handling, URL rewriting, SSL support, and server management classes.

classes.name: RequestRewriter
classes.description: Handles URL path rewriting based on specified rules.

classes.name: WebTestServer
classes.description: Custom threaded HTTP server supporting SSL and request routing.

classes.name: WebTestRequestHandler
classes.description: Handles individual HTTP requests, including parsing, routing, and response management.

classes.name: WebTestHttpd
classes.description: High-level class to configure, start, and stop the test HTTP server.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a URL rewrite rule for specific HTTP methods and paths.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Rewrites the request URL if it matches a registered rule.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes server or handler classes with configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_request_line
methods.description: Reads and validates the request line from the socket.

methods.name: handle_connect
methods.description: Handles HTTP CONNECT method, optionally enabling SSL.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, either blocking or in a separate thread.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Constructs and returns the server URL with optional path, query, and fragment.
